owner: FIX_MOVE_COVER (movement: end the move Hidden or in cover — SUR-01/SUR-03/SUR-11)
rationale: 11e 13.09 (as errata'd): an INFANTRY model is hidden while it is within a terrain area containing a light or dense feature and its unit made no ranged attacks this turn or the previous one, and a hidden model is visible only to enemy models within its detection range (15" unless stated). 06.01: a unit is visible if ANY of its models is, so untargetability needs EVERY model hidden. Here U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B (5 x 40 mm, M6) stands in a line 2.2" north of obj_nml_1's dense ruin (area-large-2, x 1360-1640) with the only enemy shooter that could reach it next turn 23" away in the open. The straight approach onto the ruin's nearest edge ends with the 5th model's base past the ruin's east edge (x 1690): four models hidden, the fifth in the open, so the whole unit can be targeted. Ending the same move about 1.4" further west costs nothing — the same objective, the same OC 10 in range, no extra turn — and puts every model inside the ruin: all five Hidden beyond the shooter's 15" detection range even after its 6" move (13.09), and every model's centre inside a terrain area for the Benefit of Cover (13.08, -1 BS) even if the squad later shoots. An AI that stops one model outside is leaving a free defensive rule on the table, not making a trade-off. Asserts 4-7 stop an AI from passing by hiding instead of taking the objective, by standing still, or by an illegal move.
